title: Finite scalar restriction package
statement: theorem finiteScalar_exists (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (_hl : l ≠ D.p) (E L : Type u) [Field E] [Field L] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [Algebra (Padic l) L] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) L] (n m : ℕ) (a : Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1) →+* Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l L (m + 1)) (T : Scheme.{u}) [T.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (T ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (T ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] : Nonempty (Scalar l E L n m a T)

proof.text: Apply the finite scalar preservation and Tor interval packages. Lift the ambient derived scalar functor to the full finite-Tor subcategory; its equality realization is definitional. Transport the canonical ambient shift through the full-subcategory lift and use the equality realization for the shift square.
